# Waaseyaa

Curated by Skill Harbor. Waaseyaa is an open-source PHP framework (built on Symfony components) for structured content, publishing workflows, and AI-assisted tools, created by Russell Jones, an Ojibwe developer from Sagamok Anishnawbek in Northern Ontario. The project's core idea: community ownership and Indigenous data sovereignty. Your content. Your infrastructure.

The AI angle: documentation is published as HTML, Markdown, and through a read-only MCP endpoint, and entity schemas automatically generate MCP tools, so AI agents can interact with content through structured tool calls. The repo ships framework-specific guidelines and skills for coding agents (CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, with an anchor-issue plus design-first workflow).

Honest caveats: Waaseyaa is still in alpha (as of 2026-10-04), and this is a developer framework, not a plug-in for your Muse. The part a Muse agent can actually use is the documentation and the generated MCP tools; the guidelines and skills files are written for coding agents in general and transfer to a Muse agent. It requires PHP 8.5 and a self-hosted server. The license is GPL-2.0-or-later, which is copyleft: if you distribute a modified build, you must share your changes under the same terms.

Source: r/AiBuilders post by u/Odd_Tomatillo_5265 (2026-10-04), project site waaseyaa.org, repo github.com/waaseyaa/framework.
